    wti = case["word_token_indices"]
    ws = case["word_scores"]
    forced = case["forced_words"]
    budget = case["token_budget"]
    n = len(wti)
    forced_set = set(forced)
    forced_tokens = sum(len(wti[i]) for i in forced)
    forced_score = sum(ws[i] for i in forced)
    remaining = [i for i in range(n) if i not in forced_set]
    rem_weights = [len(wti[i]) for i in remaining]
    rem_values = [ws[i] for i in remaining]
    cap = budget - forced_tokens
    if cap < 0:
        sel = sorted(forced)
        tokens = forced_tokens
        retained = []
        for i in sel:
            retained.extend(wti[i])
        retained.sort()
        return {"retained_token_indices": retained, "selected_words": sel, "tokens_used": tokens}
    INF_NEG = -1e9
    dp = [INF_NEG] * (cap + 1)
    dp[0] = 0.0
    best = [[] for _ in range(cap + 1)]
    for idx in range(len(remaining)):
        w = rem_weights[idx]
        v = rem_values[idx]

                new_val = dp[j - w] + v
                if new_val > dp[j] + 1e-12:
                    dp[j] = new_val
                    best[j] = best[j - w] + [idx]
    best_val = INF_NEG
    best_j = 0
    for j in range(cap + 1):
        if dp[j] > best_val + 1e-12:
            best_val = dp[j]
            best_j = j
    sel_remaining = [remaining[i] for i in best[best_j]]
    selected_words = sorted(forced + sel_remaining)
    tokens_used = forced_tokens + best_j
    retained = []
    for i in selected_words:
        retained.extend(wti[i])
    retained.sort()
    return {"retained_token_indices": retained, "selected_words": selected_words, "tokens_used": tokens_used}"
}

    forced_tokens = 0

        forced_tokens += len(word_token_indices[i])
        forced_score += word_scores[i]

    remaining_indices = [i for i in range(n) if i not in forced_set]
    remaining_weights = [len(word_token_indices[i]) for i in remaining_indices]
    remaining_values = [word_scores[i] for i in remaining_indices]

    capacity = token_budget - forced_tokens
    if capacity < 0:
        # not feasible but we'll just return forced only
        selected_words = sorted(forced_words)
        tokens_used = forced_tokens
        retained = []
        for i in selected_words:
            retained.extend(word_token_indices[i])
        retained.sort()
        return {
            "retained_token_indices": retained,
            "selected_words": selected_words,
            "tokens_used": tokens_used
        }

    # DP

    dp[0] = 0.0
    best_items = [[] for _ in range(capacity+1)]

    m = len(remaining_indices)

        w = remaining_weights[idx]
        v = remaining_values[idx]
        for j in range(capacity, w-1, -1):

    # find best j

    # selected remaining indices

    selected_words = sorted(forced_words + selected_remaining)
    tokens_used = forced_tokens + best_j
    retained = []
    for i in selected_words:
        retained.extend(word_token_indices[i])
    retained.sort()
    return {
        "retained_token_indices": retained,
        "selected_words": selected_words,
        "tokens_used": tokens_used
    }
